# Payments and transfers
## Domestic transfers
Domestic transfers made before 6 pm on a working day reach the beneficiary the same day.
## International wires
International wire transfers take two to four working days. The outward wire fee is 25 plus correspondent bank charges.
## Tracing a payment
A missing outward payment can be traced using the SWIFT gpi tracker and the payment reference (UETR). Trace requests are answered within one working day.
